Class ChaosProperties

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.spring.boot.common.ChaosProperties
@ConfigurationProperties("macstab.chaos") public class ChaosProperties extends Object
Configuration properties for the runtime chaos starter. Shared between the Spring Boot 3 and Spring Boot 4 starters — this class only uses APIs that are source- and binary-stable across both versions.

All chaos beans are gated behind isEnabled(); the agent is inert unless an operator explicitly opts in by setting macstab.chaos.enabled=true in the Spring environment.
